newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO assessed little changed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO assessed little changed.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices on Monday were assessed to be little changed but most traders were mixed on near term direction, traders said.
High sulphur, 180 centistoke fuel oil was quoted at $124/$125 per tonne on Friday.
While some traders said recovering Chinese demand were providing good market support, a Japanese trader said Chinese bids were too low.
Chinese buyers were bidding at $8 per tonne over Singapore spot quotes against offers at $9 per tonne on a cost and freight basis to south China for December delivery supplies.
Another trader said China is expected to import three more cargoes for deliveries in the second half of December.
Traders said Mideast supplies were also heading East. A Bahrain cargo is also arriving in December, said one trader.
Traders said there are still various South Korean supplies available and one more unsold cargo in Japan.
Late Monday, a mid December cargo was bid at $124.50 per tonne.
In the swaps market, December was bid/asked at $119.50/$120.25, unchanged from Friday's quotes.
